verses.gurmukhi: ਪੰਜ ਤਤ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਕਰਿ ਧਰਮਸਾਲ ਧਰਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: pa(n)j tat paravaan kar dharamasaal dharatee man bhaanee|

en.bdb: As a result of the rational combination of five elements this lovely abode of dharma in the form of earth has been created.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਣੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਧਰਤਿ ਧਰਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਧਰਿਆ ਪਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: paanee a(n)dhar dharat dhar dharatee a(n)dhar dhariaa paanee|

en.bdb: The earth is placed in water and again in earth, water is placed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰ ਤਲਵਾਏ ਰੁਖ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਚਿਤ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਬਿਬਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: sir talavaae rukh hoi nihachal chit nivaas bibaanee|

en.bdb: Having their heads downward i.e. the trees rooted in earth grow on it and reside in the deep lone forests.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਸੁਫਲ ਫਲਿ ਵਟ ਵਗਾਇ ਸਿਰਠਿ ਵਰਸਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: paraupakaaree sufal fal vaT vagai siraTh varasaanee|

en.bdb: These trees are also altruists which when stoned rain fruits for the creatures on earth.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾਸੁ ਵਣਾਸਪਤਿ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਵਾਸੁ ਮਹਿਕਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: cha(n)dhan vaas vanaasapat cha(n)dhan hoi vaas mahikaanee|

en.bdb: The fragrance of sandal makes the whole vegetation fragrant.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat liv saadhasa(n)g gurmukh sukh fal a(n)mirat vaanee|

en.bdb: In the holy company of Gurmukhs the consciousness is merged into Word and man attains the fruits of delight through the ambrosial speech.
Ineffable is the story of the unmanifest Lord; His dynamism is unknowable.
